def M6_S1_SingleAuthoritativeShard():
    state_name = controlplane.migration_state
    donor = donor_authoritative(state_name)
    recipient = recipient_authoritative(state_name)
    return (donor and not recipient) or (recipient and not donor)

# M6-S2: every write accepted during dual-writing is present on the recipient
# by the time CATCHING_UP has exited.

invariants.name: M6_S2_NoLostDualWrites
invariants.pyCode:
def M6_S2_NoLostDualWrites():
    state_name = controlplane.migration_state
    if accepted_during_dual_write and state_name in ["fencing_old", "cutover", "verifying", "gc_eligible", "done"]:
        return shards[1].has_bucket[0] and not pending_recipient_dual_write
    return True

# M6-S3: GC_ELIGIBLE is never entered before the consumer frontier passes the
# cutover epoch.

invariants.name: M6_S3_GcEligibleFrontierGate
invariants.pyCode:
def M6_S3_GcEligibleFrontierGate():
    if controlplane.migration_state == "gc_eligible":
        return consumer.frontier >= controlplane.cutover_epoch
    return True

# M6-L1: from any non-terminal state, the migration always eventually reaches
# either DONE or ABORTED. The exact successful/abort branch is intentionally
# nondeterministic.

invariants.name: M6_L1_EventuallyCompletesOrAborts
invariants.pyCode:
def M6_L1_EventuallyCompletesOrAborts():
    return controlplane.migration_state in ["done", "aborted"]
